scope: archive 63, the developer debug menu: its switches, its item-grant confirmations and the Boktai crossover NPC whose three tournament messages it previews
provenance: Claude, 2026-09-20; wording decided against translations/story_source.jsonl and the terminology adopted in batches 001-018
tone: Developer shorthand, so noun endings and flat 합니다체 for the switches; the crossover NPC keeps his own friendly 반말.
notes: This is the debug menu, not player-facing copy -- its wording should not be taken as a precedent for the shop and pickup lines it resembles. 91 of the 146 records are the one line 「」をゲッツ. 「太陽しょうねん」 is the in-game name of the Boktai comic, kept as 태양소년.

by_source.そのナビは すさまじく\nつよくてね、もうぜったい\nデリートされるって おもっ:
그 내비는 엄청나게
강해서、이젠 확실히
삭제되겠구나 싶었을 때
by_source.オズマかんとく\nトーナメントけっしょうせん時\nメッセージ:
오즈마 감독
토너먼트 결승전 때
메시지
by_source.ジャンゴと おてんこさまは、\n今も インターネットの どこかで\nたたかいつづ:
장고와 오텐코 님은、
지금도 인터넷 어딘가에서
계속 싸우고 있을 거야!
by_source.ダークソウル出現\nただし、シナリオのフラグを\n立てているので、シナリオを:
다크 소울 출현
단、시나리오 플래그를
세워 두었으므로、시나리오를

단、시나리오 클리어 플래그를
세워 두었기에、이 상태로
by_source.ボクのナビのまえに\nきゅうけつきタイプのナビが\nあらわれたんだ:
내 내비 앞에
흡혈귀 타입 내비가
나타났어
by_source.今も どこかで、ジャンゴは\nきゅうけつき と\nたたかっているんじゃないかな?:

흡혈귀와

held_reason: archive 63 carries no pointer claim, so the build has nothing to repoint and the Korean would sit in the ROM unread. Five archives are in this position ROM-wide: 43, 44, 56, 57 and 63. The wording is kept because it is finished and checked; preparing it is refused until the archive is shown to be reachable, and setting accept_unrelocatable in this file is the only way past that refusal.
revisions: 2026-09-27: ナビカス is the menu word 내비커스; this batch had 내비 커스텀. Glossary exe4-term-044.
